title: Nine Years and a Bent Door
subtitle: 后背与后方 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 后背与后方（人与自我·身体与方位）
meta: 主题语境：后背与后方（人与自我·身体与方位）　|　核心词汇：back　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 back 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather put out ① his back lifting a stove and said the stove had won, and he was right for nine years. The ② back, meaning the whole thing and not the pain, carried everything and was thanked never; a back, my grandmother said, is the only part of you that does the work and gets the blame for stopping. She said the blame lasts longer than the work.

Every ③ back in that family went at some point, and she said that was the family inheritance. Their ④ back — the one the doctor wrote about in March — had nine words in the notes and one of them was wrong; a back, my father said, is the only part of a body that is treated as a machine and resents it. He said the resentment shows in the way a man stands.

My mother used the word the other way and meant ⑤ the back of the house, which was colder and had the better view. The ⑥ back, meaning the rear of a thing and not the part of a body, is the only side that everybody uses and nobody photographs; a back, she said, is where a house keeps what it is ashamed of. She said every house has nine such things.

By 1964 he was sleeping against the ⑦ back of the door, meaning a board laid against it, and he said that was the cure. The ⑧ back of the photograph had nine words in pencil, and nobody in the family could read them; a back, my father said, is either a part of you or the side things are written on. He said only one of them is kept in a drawer.

The ⑨ back I remember is his, bent at ninety degrees in 1966, which he said was nine degrees better than the year before. A ⑩ back, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing in a body that everybody relies on and nobody thinks about until it stops; every back, she said, is carrying more than it was built for. She said that is true of people too.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 背（指整个背部，与疼痛相对）
C. n. 背（指医生笔记里写的那一个）
D. 固定搭配：put out one's back 扭伤腰背
E. n. 后面；背面（某物的后部）
F. n. 背面（抽象：事物不示人的一面）
G. n. 背面（指照片背面）
H. n. 背部（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The back, meaning the whole thing and not the pain
The back, meaning the rear of a thing
A back, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: put out one's back 意为“扭伤腰背”，1957 年祖父搬炉子时扭伤了背，说炉子赢了，此后九年他说得都对。
back 指“整个背部”，与疼痛相对，它扛下所有东西，却从没被谢过一次。
back 意为“背、背部”，那一家人里每一个人的背都会在某一刻出问题，她说那就是这家人的遗传。
back 指医生笔记里写的那一个，医生三月写下的笔记里只有九个词，其中一个还是错的。
back 意为“后面、后部”，母亲说的是另一回事：屋子后面更冷，视野却更好。
back 意为“背面（抽象）”，指事物的后部而不是身体的一部分，它是人人都用、却没人拍照的一面。
back 意为“后部、背面”，到 1964 年他靠着门的背面睡觉，指的是抵在门上的一块板，他说那就是疗法。
back 意为“背面”，照片背面用铅笔写了九个词，家里没人认得出来。
back 意为“背”，我记得的是他的背，1966 年弯成九十度，他说比前一年好了九度。
back 为抽象总称，泛指“背部这种部位”，祖母说背部是身体上人人都倚靠、却直到它停了才被想起的东西。
